_purpose: Persistent state for the Claude supervisor routine (every-4h check). Read at the start of each check, written at the end. Survives across sessions.

_field_docs.last_check_ts: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the previous successful check.
_field_docs.last_balance: Account balance at end of previous check.
_field_docs.peak_balance: Highest balance ever observed across all checks. Used for drawdown calc.
_field_docs.open_positions: Snapshot of open positions at last check (list of dicts).
_field_docs.trades_since_last: Trade count between previous and most-recent check.
_field_docs.alerts_active: List of currently-flagged anomalies. Cleared when conditions resolve.
_field_docs.consecutive_silent_checks: Number of consecutive checks with zero new trades. Used to flag dead bot.
_field_docs.next_check_ts: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the routine should fire next. Cadence escalates with drawdown.
_field_docs.last_report_path: Path to the most recent supervisor report markdown file.
